servinfo.title: Front Seat Belt Assembly Removal and Installation

attention1.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when servicing seat belt pretensioner may result in personal injury.

item.ptxt: Do not disassemble or repair seat belt components. If any abnormalities are found, replace the seat belt components with a new replacement set.
Before servicing the seat belt, read Precautions for Service and Diagnosis of Seat Belt and follow all the instructions provided.

attention3.ptxt: Refer to Repair and Inspection Required after Accident before replacing an activated pretensioner.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect connector (1) from seat belt pretensioner (2) as follows.

s2.ptxt: Release lock button (3) by pulling it in arrow direction “1”.
Disconnect connector with lock released by pulling it in arrow direction “2”.

s1.ptxt: Remove bolts of front seat belt assembly and then remove front seat belt assembly.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Fit claw (2) on seat belt pretensioner (1) into cutout (3) on body panel.
Tighten bolts of front seat belt assembly in numerical order to specified torque.
Connect connector (2) to seat belt pretensioner (1) as follows.
Connect connector to seat belt pretensioner with lock button (3) released by pushing it in arrow direction “1”.
Press lock button to lock connector securely by pushing it in arrow direction “2”.
